label: Is in planning subset
summary: Whether a character is in a named group of guests (such as 'spectator') of an activity phase that is being planned.
details: It takes three arguments. Vanilla's tournament contest screen passes the planned phase, the player and the group name 'spectator', and feeds the result into the alpha, alwaystransparent and down properties of a widget. The game documents nothing more.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.Self

fields.name: Arg2
fields.text: The name of the guest group.

label: Is editing a phase
summary: Going by its name, whether any phase of the activity being planned is currently being edited.
details: Vanilla's tournament contest screen uses it, and its negation, for the visible property of widgets.

label: Is editing an option
summary: Going by its name, whether an activity option is currently being edited in the planner.
details: Vanilla's activity planner window uses it for the visible property of widgets.

label: Is editing this phase
summary: A yes/no value taking two arguments; going by its name it asks whether a given phase is being edited in the planner.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more, so what the two arguments are is not known.

label: Is first picked phase
summary: Going by its name, whether the given phase is the first of the phases picked for the activity.
details: Vanilla uses its negation for the enabled property of a widget in the planner window, and in two visibility checks of the tournament contest screen.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase, for example PlannedActivityPhase.Self or ActivityPlanner.GetEditingPhase

label: Is last picked phase
summary: Going by its name, whether the given phase is the last of the phases picked for the activity.
details: Vanilla uses its negation for the enabled property of a widget in the activity planner window.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.Self

label: Is planning stage
summary: Going by its name, whether the planner is currently in the named planning stage.
details: Vanilla asks for the stages 'options' and 'special_option_category' to decide which part of the planner window is visible.

label: Is selecting doctrine
summary: Going by its name, whether a doctrine is currently being selected in the planner.
details: Vanilla uses it for the visible property of a widget in the activity planner window.

label: Is selecting tenet
summary: Going by its name, whether a tenet is currently being selected in the planner.
details: Vanilla uses it for the visible property of a widget in the activity planner window.

label: Is tenet doctrine based
summary: A yes/no value that vanilla uses to switch between two layouts in the planner window.
details: Going by its name, it says whether the selection being made is based on doctrines. The game documents nothing more.

label: Move phase earlier
summary: Going by its name, moves a phase earlier in the order of the planned activity.
details: Vanilla runs it from a click, passing the phase of the clicked row. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.AccessSelf

label: Move phase later
summary: Going by its name, moves a phase later in the order of the planned activity.
details: Vanilla runs it from a click, passing the phase of the clicked row. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.AccessSelf

label: No operation
summary: A function that returns a text (CString); going by its name it does nothing visible.
details: Vanilla's only use puts it directly before ActivityOption.GetDescription in a localization text. The game documents nothing more.

label: Open doctrine selection
summary: Opens the choice list for the doctrine in the given slot.
details: Vanilla runs it from clicks with the numbers 0, 1 and 2, so it seems to offer three doctrine slots. It returns nothing.

label: Open tenet selection
summary: Opens the choice list for the tenet in the given slot.
details: Vanilla runs it from clicks with the numbers 0, 1 and 2, so it seems to offer three tenet slots. It returns nothing.

label: Open special option selection
summary: Going by its name, opens the selection of the special option of the activity being planned.
details: Vanilla runs it from clicks in the activity planner window. It returns nothing.

label: Pick doctrine
summary: Picks the given doctrine in the planner's doctrine selection.
details: Vanilla runs it on a click, passing DoctrineType.Self, in the doctrine and tenet selection part of the planner. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a doctrine type, vanilla passes DoctrineType.Self

label: Pick tenet
summary: Picks the given tenet in the planner's tenet selection.
details: Vanilla runs it on a click, passing TenetItem.GetTenet, in the doctrine and tenet selection part of the planner. It returns nothing.

label: Previous stage was
summary: Going by its name, whether the planning stage before the multi-destination selection was the named one.
details: Vanilla asks for 'options' together with IsPlanningStage('options') in one visibility check of the planner window.

label: Next planning stage
summary: Going by its name, moves the planner on to its next planning stage.
details: Vanilla runs it from clicks in the activity planner window. It returns nothing.

label: Remove guest from group
summary: Going by its name, takes a character out of a named guest group of a phase being planned.
details: Vanilla's tournament contest screen removes the player from the groups 'spectator' and 'contestant' this way, when the screen opens and when a button is clicked. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.AccessSelf

fields.name: Arg2
fields.text: The name of the guest group.

label: Remove phase
summary: Removes a phase from the activity being planned.
details: Vanilla runs it from button clicks, passing the clicked row's phase or the phase being edited. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase, for example PlannedActivityPhase.AccessSelf or ActivityPlanner.AccessEditingPhase

label: Select option
summary: Selects the given activity option in the planner.
details: Vanilla runs it on a click, passing ActivityOption.Self. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: an activity option, vanilla passes ActivityOption.Self

label: Select phase type
summary: Going by its name, selects the given type of phase in the planner.
details: Vanilla runs it on a click in the tournament contest screen, passing ActivityPhase.Self. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: an activity phase, vanilla passes ActivityPhase.Self

label: Select phase type for a phase
summary: Going by its name, selects the given type of phase for one given planned phase.
details: Vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.AccessSelf and ActivityPhase.Self on a click. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.AccessSelf

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The phase type to give it.
fields.values: an activity phase, vanilla passes ActivityPhase.Self

label: Selectable doctrines
summary: Going by its name, the list of doctrines that can be selected in the planner.
details: Vanilla uses it as the datamodel of the doctrine and tenet selection part of the planner. The game does not name its return type.

label: Selectable tenets
summary: Going by its name, the list of tenets that can be selected in the planner.
details: Vanilla uses it as the datamodel of the doctrine and tenet selection part of the planner. The game does not name its return type.

label: The planner itself
summary: The activity planner itself, so it can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how other types' Self is used in vanilla (passed on as an argument). The lines vanilla shows for this name belong to other types. The game documents nothing more.

label: Start editing option
summary: Starts editing an activity option in the planner; going by its name it takes the option to edit.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, the option to edit.

label: Start editing phase
summary: Going by its name, starts editing a planned phase.
details: Vanilla's tournament contest screen passes the phase and either 'destination' or 'phase' on a click, so the second argument seems to say what is edited. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.AccessSelf

label: Start picking location
summary: Going by its name, starts picking a location.
details: Vanilla runs it from a click in the travel planner window. It returns nothing.

label: Start destination selection
summary: Going by its name, starts the selection of several destinations in the planner.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Start phase planning
summary: Going by its name, starts the planning of the activity's phases.
details: Vanilla runs it from a click in the tournament's selected contests part. It returns nothing.

label: Stop editing option
summary: Going by its name, ends the editing of an activity option in the planner.
details: Vanilla runs it from a click in the activity planner window. It returns nothing.

label: Toggle editing option
summary: Going by its name, switches the editing of the given activity option on or off.
details: Vanilla runs it from a click, passing ActiveActivityOption.AccessSelf. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: an active activity option, vanilla passes ActiveActivityOption.AccessSelf

label: The map icon itself
summary: The planner map icon itself, in a form that can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how AccessSelf is used with other types in vanilla (passed on to a window function). The game documents nothing more.

label: Can select destination
summary: Going by its name, whether the player can pick this map icon as a destination.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it together with IsSelectedDestination to decide whether the icon is visible. The game documents nothing more.

label: Activity type
summary: The type of activity the map icon is about.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it as the data context for parts of the icon. The game does not name its return type.

label: Province
summary: Going by its name, the province the map icon belongs to.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it as the data context for parts of the icon. The game does not name its return type.

label: Province tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tooltip text for the map icon's province.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it as the icon's tooltip.

label: Travel danger data
summary: Going by its name, the data about the travel danger of the map icon's place.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it as a datacontext. The game does not name its return type.

label: Travel points of interest data
summary: Going by its name, the data about the travel points of interest of the map icon's place.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it as a datacontext. The game does not name its return type.

label: Has travel danger
summary: Going by its name, whether travelling to this map icon's place carries a danger.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer combines it with Not(IsSelectedDestination) to decide whether an icon part is visible. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has points of interest
summary: Going by its name, whether the map icon's place has travel points of interest.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it to show or hide the points of interest part of the icon.

label: Provisions critical
summary: Going by its name, whether the travel provisions are at a critical level.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it to show or hide a part of the icon.

label: Provisions low
summary: Going by its name, whether the travel provisions are low.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it to show or hide a part of the icon.

label: Is capital
summary: Going by its name, whether the map icon's place is a capital.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it to show or hide a part of the icon.

label: Is current location
summary: Whether the map icon's place is where the traveller is now.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it to show or hide a part of the icon. The meaning rests on the name.

label: Is selected destination
summary: Going by its name, whether the map icon's place is a selected destination.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it in several visibility checks, for instance as And(HasTravelDanger, Not(IsSelectedDestination)).

label: Is selecting destinations
summary: Going by its name, whether the player is currently choosing destinations.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer uses it in a visibility check that also asks about the planner type and the selected destination.

label: Click map icon
summary: Going by its name, runs the click handling of the map icon.
details: Vanilla's map icon layer runs it when the icon is clicked. It returns nothing. What the click does depends on the planner state; the game documents nothing more.

label: The map icon itself
summary: The planner map icon itself, so it can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how other types' Self is used in vanilla. The lines vanilla shows for this name belong to other types. The game documents nothing more.

label: The pulse action itself
summary: The activity pulse action itself, in a form that can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how AccessSelf is used with other types. The game documents nothing more.

label: Icon
summary: Going by its name, the icon of the activity pulse action.
details: Vanilla uses it as the texture of an image in the shared popups.

label: Has icon
summary: Going by its name, whether the activity pulse action has an icon.
details: Vanilla does not use it for this type; it uses HasIcon of other types the same way, to show or hide an icon.

label: The pulse action itself
summary: The activity pulse action itself, so it can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how other types' Self is used in vanilla. The game documents nothing more.

label: The pulse effect itself
summary: The activity pulse effect itself, in a form that can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how AccessSelf is used with other types. The game documents nothing more.

label: Effect text
summary: Going by its name, the text that describes the activity pulse effect.
details: Vanilla uses it as the text of a label in the shared popups.

label: Left side
summary: Going by its name, the left-hand side of the pulse effect; it returns a scope.
details: Vanilla reads its .Char, .Title and .Artifact parts as data contexts in the shared popups. It pairs with GetRight.

label: Right side
summary: Going by its name, the right-hand side of the pulse effect; it returns a scope.
details: Vanilla reads its .Char, .Title and .Artifact parts as data contexts in the shared popups. It pairs with GetLeft.

label: Title
summary: Going by its name, the title text of the activity pulse effect.
details: Vanilla uses it as the text of a label in the shared popups.

label: Is valid
summary: Going by its name, whether the pulse effect object exists and can be used.
details: Vanilla has no line for this exact type; the name is used very often with other types in this way.

label: The pulse effect itself
summary: The activity pulse effect itself, so it can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how other types' Self is used in vanilla. The game documents nothing more.

label: The special guest itself
summary: The special guest slot itself, in a form that can be handed on as an argument.
details: Vanilla's planner window passes it to OpenGameViewData to open the activity guest list for this slot.

label: Clear character
summary: Going by its name, removes the chosen character from the special guest.
details: Vanilla runs it on a right click in the planner window. It returns nothing.

label: Character
summary: Going by its name, the character of the special guest.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a character widget, and asks .IsValid on it to see whether the slot is filled. The game does not name its return type.

label: Special guest type
summary: Going by its name, the special guest type of the special guest.
details: Vanilla reads its name from it with .GetNameForHost() and .GetNameIfHost(...) in planner tooltips. The game does not name its return type.

label: The special guest itself
summary: The special guest slot itself, so it can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how other types' Self is used in vanilla. The game documents nothing more.

label: The guest type itself
summary: The special guest type itself, in a form that can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how AccessSelf is used with other types. The game documents nothing more.

label: Description for guest
summary: Going by its name, the description of this special guest type as the guest sees it.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Description for host
summary: Going by its name, the description of this special guest type as the host sees it.
details: Vanilla's planner tooltip for a special guest (ACTIVITY_PLANNER_SPECIAL_GUEST_PLANNING_TT) uses it after the type's host-side name. The game documents nothing more.

label: Description if host
summary: Going by its name, a description of this special guest type that depends on a host given as the argument.
details: Vanilla's tooltips pass ActivityGuestListWindow.GetHost to the sibling GetNameIfHost, next to this function. Exactly how the host changes the text is not documented.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; vanilla passes the activity's host (ActivityGuestListWindow.GetHost) to the sibling GetNameIfHost.

label: Name for guest
summary: The name of this special guest type as the guest sees it.
details: Vanilla uses it in the text 'As the ... the activity will wait for you to begin', shown when joining requires a special guest.

label: Name for host
summary: The name of this special guest type as the host sees it.
details: Vanilla uses it in planner texts such as the one for a guest declining the role.

label: Name if host
summary: The name of a special guest role, written for the given host.
details: Vanilla's activity window passes the activity's host: "attending this ... as the [role]". How the host changes the name is not documented.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The host the name is written for.
fields.values: the host character, in vanilla Activity.GetHost

label: Has auto-selected character
summary: Going by its name, whether the game picks a character for this special guest type on its own.
details: Vanilla uses the name twice; the lines are not shown. The game documents nothing more.

label: Is required
summary: Whether this special guest type is required for the activity.
details: Vanilla's activity list window uses it to show or hide parts of the list.

label: The guest type itself
summary: The special guest type itself, so it can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how other types' Self is used in vanilla. The game documents nothing more.

label: The activity type itself
summary: The activity type itself, in a form that can be handed on as an argument.
details: Going by its name and by how AccessSelf is used with other types. The game documents nothing more.

label: Cooldown days
summary: Going by its name, the number of days of cooldown before the given character can host this activity type again.
details: Vanilla uses it inside GetTimeDifferenceWithDays in the message 'Cannot host another ... for ...'. The argument is not documented; it is probably the character.

label: Pickable phases allowed
summary: Going by its name, how many phases the player may pick for this activity type.
details: The argument is not documented. Vanilla uses the name nine times, but the lines are not shown.

label: Can always plan
summary: Going by its name, whether this activity type can always be planned.
details: Vanilla's activity list window shows a part when the activity is not ongoing and neither CanPlanActivity(player) nor CanAlwaysPlan is true.

label: Can plan activity
summary: Going by its name, whether the given character can plan an activity of this type.
details: Vanilla's activity list window passes the player and shows different parts depending on the result, for items that are not ongoing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character who would plan it.

label: Can start activity
summary: Going by its name, whether the given character can start an activity of this type.
details: Vanilla's government administration and dynastic cycle windows pass the player and use it for the enabled property of a widget.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character who would start it.

label: Custom text
summary: Going by its name and use, a custom text of the activity type, found by a key.
details: The name is used over eleven thousand times in the game's texts (all types together), written as Type.Custom('key'). The argument is not documented; going by that use it is a key.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The key of the custom text.

label: Joinable activity
summary: The joinable activity of this type, if there is one.
details: Vanilla's government administration window uses it as a data context. The game does not name its return type.

label: Joinable open activity
summary: The joinable open activity of this type, if there is one.
details: Vanilla's government administration window uses it as a data context. The game does not name its return type.

label: Can-plan tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains whether the given character can plan this activity type.
details: Vanilla joins it into the activity's tooltip with JoinText.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character who would plan it.

label: Can-start tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tooltip text that explains whether the given character can start this activity type.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Description
summary: The description text of the activity type.
details: Vanilla shows it in the activity list window's detail part and in a shared tooltip, and uses it in one localization text.

label: Guest intents
summary: Going by its name, the list of intents a guest can have for this activity type.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Guest invite rules
summary: Going by its name, the list of guest invite rules of this activity type.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list of the activity guest list window.

label: Header background
summary: The background picture for the header of this activity type, for the given character.
details: Vanilla's activity list window uses it as a texture and passes the player.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the header is for.

label: Header icon
summary: The icon shown in the header of this activity type.
details: Vanilla's activity window uses it as a texture.

label: Host description
summary: Going by its use, the text of the rewards the given host can expect from this activity type.
details: Vanilla puts it after the text 'Anticipated Rewards from hosting' in the activity list window. The argument is not documented.

label: Host intents
summary: Going by its name, the list of host intents of this activity type.
details: Vanilla's activity planner window counts the list: it shows one layout when there is at most one intent and another when there are more.

label: Icon
summary: The icon of the activity type.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the map icon layer, the activity list and the succession event window.

label: Index
summary: Going by its name, the number of the activity type in the game's list of types.
details: Vanilla's lines for this name are not shown here. The game documents nothing more.

label: Key
summary: Going by its name, the key of the activity type, as a text.
details: Vanilla compares it with texts such as 'activity_journey' to treat one activity type differently on the map icons.

label: Last seen date of open activity
summary: The date when an open activity of this type was last seen, as a text.
details: Vanilla shows it in the government administration window. Going by its name, it is about open activities of this type.

label: Localized text
summary: A text belonging to this activity type, found by a key.
details: Vanilla asks for keys like 'predicted_cost' to show parts of the activity's description, such as its average cost.

label: Localized text with fallback
summary: A text belonging to this activity type, found by a key, with a second localization key used when the type has none.
details: Vanilla passes 'special_guests' and the key of a default text. The second argument is a fallback key going by the name and the use.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The localization key used if the activity type has no such text.

label: Maximum guests
summary: Going by its name, the largest number of guests this activity type allows.
details: Vanilla uses the name twice; the lines are not shown. The game documents nothing more.

label: Name
summary: The name of the activity type; going by the sibling GetNameNoTooltip, it carries a tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in many texts. The variant GetNameNoTooltip gives the name without the tooltip.

label: Name without tooltip
summary: The name of the activity type, as plain text with no tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in button texts such as 'Finalize ...' and 'Edit ...'. Compare GetName.

label: Option categories
summary: Going by its name, the list of option categories of this activity type.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Option category by key
summary: Going by its name, the option category of this activity type that has the given key.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by the name, the category's key.

label: Phases
summary: Going by its name, the list of phases of this activity type.
details: Vanilla uses the name six times (all types together); the lines are not shown.

label: Pickable phases
summary: Going by its name, the list of phases that can be picked for this activity type.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list of the planner window and counts it in the tournament contest screen.

label: Planner type
summary: Going by its name, the kind of planner this activity type uses, as a text.
details: Vanilla never uses it, but it uses IsPlannerType with texts such as 'province' and 'holder'. The game documents nothing more.

label: Province description
summary: Going by its name, a text that describes a province for this activity type.

label: Special option category
summary: Going by its name, the special option category of this activity type.

label: Text icon
summary: Going by its name, the small icon of this activity type for use inside a text.
details: Vanilla uses the name 198 times (all types together); the lines are not shown.

label: Text icon without format
summary: Going by its name, the text icon of this activity type without text formatting.
details: Compare GetTextIcon. Vanilla uses the name three times; the lines are not shown.

label: Predicted cost
summary: Going by its name, the predicted cost of this activity type for the given character, ready to show.
details: Vanilla uses it with the |U format in the text 'Average Cost'.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the cost is for.

label: Has header icon
summary: Going by its name, whether this activity type has a header icon.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Has icon
summary: Going by its name, whether this activity type has an icon.

label: Has pickable phases
summary: Going by its name, whether the player can pick phases for this activity type.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Has predefined phases
summary: Going by its name, whether this activity type has phases that are fixed in advance.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Has special option category
summary: Going by its name, whether this activity type has a special option category.
details: Vanilla never uses it, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Is open invite

summary: Going by its name, whether this activity type uses the named kind of planner.

label: Is single location

details: Vanilla uses its texture as the window's picture and also as a data context.

label: Position in guest group
summary: The place of the given character in a named guest group of the current phase, as a number.
details: Vanilla's imperial examination scoreboard uses it with the group 'entrants' and the player, inside size and visibility checks together with IsCharacterInCurrentPhaseGuestSubset. What happens for a character not in the group is not documented.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the guest group.

label: Characters
summary: The list of characters shown in the activity window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list of the activity window. The game does not name its return type.

label: Guests in current phase group
summary: Going by its name, the list of guests in a named group of the current phase.
details: Vanilla uses it with group names to count the supporters or detractors in the coronation window and to fill lists.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the guest group.

label: Group size label
summary: A label with the size of a named guest group of the current phase.
details: Vanilla uses it in the coronation window with the groups 'innovator' and 'conservative'.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the guest group.

label: Event window insert
summary: The part of the window where an activity event is shown, built for the given widget.
details: Vanilla passes PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf and uses the result as a data context in the activity windows.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The widget the insert is for.

label: Guest sublist
summary: Going by its name, a sub-list of the activity's guests chosen by two arguments.
details: The arguments are not documented, and vanilla's lines are not shown here.

label: Guest group keys
summary: Going by its name, the list of keys (names) of the guest groups of the activity.
details: Vanilla uses the name once; the line is not shown. The game documents nothing more.

label: Intent tooltip
summary: The tooltip text about the intent in the activity window.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the activity window. Going by its name it is about the host's or guest's intent.

label: Last weekly pulse effect
summary: The data of the last weekly pulse effect of the activity.
details: Vanilla uses it in the tooltip of a phase in progress to show the 'Last action'.

label: Special progress value
summary: The current value of the activity's special progress, as a fixed-point number.
details: Vanilla uses it in the coronation window's tooltips, next to the coronation magnificence concept.

label: Progress segment description
summary: The description of one segment of the special progress bar.
details: Vanilla passes the segment number (the widget's index minus one) and uses it as a tooltip.

label: Has active event
summary: Going by its name, whether an event is currently shown in the activity window.
details: Vanilla uses Not(HasActiveEvent) to show parts of the window only when no event is active.

label: Is active progress level
summary: Whether the given level of the special progress bar is the active one.
details: Vanilla passes the value of the bar item to show or hide marks on the progress bar.

label: Is in current phase group
summary: Going by its name, whether a character is in a named guest group of the current phase.
details: Vanilla's imperial examination scoreboard asks it for the group 'entrants' and the player.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the guest group.
